method: Official GitHub Contributors pages, All / Commits / current default branch, observed rendered account cards. Absent-account conclusions require all displayed contributor positions to be loaded and observed. All page branches were matched against current repository metadata.
notes: All 52 eligible accepted-contribution repositories were freshly checked on 2026-11-28; no old rank observation was substituted.
GitHub graph commit counts, independently enumerated author commits, and directly merged author PR counts are distinct metrics. REST contributor ordering was not used.
The nine absence checks cover eight complete 100-card displayed lists plus MiniMind’s complete 30-card list. A dash indicates absence from that displayed list, not absence of contribution.
